# Game Idea: Canvas Escape

- **Genre**: Endless runner.
- **Core mechanic**: Control a square that jumps over procedurally generated obstacles on a scrolling platform.
- **Controls**: Press space or click to jump.
- **Lose condition**: Colliding with an obstacle or falling off the platform ends the game.
- **Goal**: Survive as long as possible; score is distance traveled.

1: // Simple endless runner based on IDEA.md
2: (() => {
3:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
4:   if (!canvas) return;
5:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
6:   canvas.width = 800;
7:   canvas.height = 200;
8: 
9:   // Sound assets (provide your own audio files at these paths)
10:   const jumpSound = new Audio('jump.wav');
11:   const hitSound = new Audio('hit.wav');
12:   const bgMusic = new Audio('bg.mp3');
13:   bgMusic.loop = true;
14:   bgMusic.volume = 0.3;
15:   bgMusic.play().catch(() => {}); // ignore autoplay block
16: 
17:   const player = { x: 50, y: 150, size: 20, vy: 0, onGround: true };
18:   const gravity = 0.8;
19:   const jumpStrength = -12;
20:   const obstacles = [];
21:   const obstacleFreq = 1500; // ms
22:   const clouds = [];
23:   const cloudFreq = 5000; // ms
24:   let lastCloud = 0;
25:   let lastObstacle = 0;
26:   let distance = 0;
27:   let gameOver = false;
28: 
29:   function spawnObstacle() {
30:     const height = 20 + Math.random() * 30;
31:     obstacles.push({ x: canvas.width, y: canvas.height - height, w: 20, h: height });
32:   }
33: 
34:   function spawnCloud() {
35:     const r = 15 + Math.random() * 20;
36:     const y = 20 + Math.random() * (canvas.height / 2);
37:     clouds.push({ x: canvas.width, y, r });
38:   }
39: 
40:   function reset() {
41:     player.y = 150;
42:     player.vy = 0;
43:     player.onGround = true;
44:     obstacles.length = 0;
45:     clouds.length = 0;
46:     distance = 0;
47:     lastObstacle = 0;
48:     lastCloud = 0;
49:     gameOver = false;
50:   }
51: 
52:   function update(dt) {
53:     if (gameOver) return;
54:     // player physics
55:     player.vy += gravity;
56:     player.y += player.vy;
57:     if (player.y + player.size >= canvas.height) {
58:       player.y = canvas.height - player.size;
59:       player.vy = 0;
60:       player.onGround = true;
61:     } else {
62:       player.onGround = false;
63:     }
64:     // obstacles move left
65:     for (let i = obstacles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
66:       const o = obstacles[i];
67:       o.x -= dt * 0.3; // speed
68:       // collision
69:       if (
70:         player.x < o.x + o.w &&
71:         player.x + player.size > o.x &&
72:         player.y < o.y + o.h &&
73:         player.y + player.size > o.y
74:       ) {
75:         if (!gameOver) {
76:           hitSound.currentTime = 0;
77:           hitSound.play().catch(() => {});
78:         }
79:         gameOver = true;
80:       }
81:       // remove off-screen
82:       if (o.x + o.w < 0) obstacles.splice(i, 1);
83:     }
84:     // clouds move left
85:     for (let i = clouds.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
86:       const c = clouds[i];
87:       c.x -= dt * 0.1; // slower than obstacles
88:       if (c.x + c.r < 0) clouds.splice(i, 1);
89:     }
90:     // spawn new obstacles
91:     if (performance.now() - lastObstacle > obstacleFreq) {
92:       spawnObstacle();
93:       lastObstacle = performance.now();
94:     }
95:     // spawn new clouds
96:     if (performance.now() - lastCloud > cloudFreq) {
97:       spawnCloud();
98:       lastCloud = performance.now();
99:     }
100:     distance += dt * 0.3;
101:   }
102: 
103:   function draw() {
104:     // sky background gradient
105:     const skyGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, canvas.height);
106:     skyGrad.addColorStop(0, '#87CEEB'); // light blue
107:     skyGrad.addColorStop(1, '#87CEFA'); // slightly deeper
108:     ctx.fillStyle = skyGrad;
109:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
110: 
111:     // draw simple clouds (circles)
112:     ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.8)';
113:     clouds && clouds.forEach(c => {
114:       ctx.beginPath();
115:       ctx.arc(c.x, c.y, c.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
116:       ctx.fill();
117:     });
118: 
119:     // ground with gradient
120:     const groundGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, canvas.height - 10, 0, canvas.height);
121:     groundGrad.addColorStop(0, '#4B8B3B');
122:     groundGrad.addColorStop(1, '#3A5F35');
123:     ctx.fillStyle = groundGrad;
124:     ctx.fillRect(0, canvas.height - 10, canvas.width, 10);
125: 
126:     // player as a circle with radial gradient
127:     const pGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(
128:       player.x + player.size / 2,
129:       player.y + player.size / 2,
130:       player.size / 8,
131:       player.x + player.size / 2,
132:       player.y + player.size / 2,
133:       player.size / 2
134:     );
135:     pGrad.addColorStop(0, '#6FFF6F');
136:     pGrad.addColorStop(1, '#0A7F0A');
137:     ctx.fillStyle = pGrad;
138:     ctx.beginPath();
139:     ctx.arc(player.x + player.size / 2, player.y + player.size / 2, player.size / 2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
140:     ctx.fill();
141: 
142:     // obstacles with a subtle colour variation
143:     obstacles.forEach(o => {
144:       const oGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(o.x, o.y, o.x, o.y + o.h);
145:       oGrad.addColorStop(0, '#C33');
146:       oGrad.addColorStop(1, '#700');
147:       ctx.fillStyle = oGrad;
148:       ctx.fillRect(o.x, o.y, o.w, o.h);
149:     });
150: 
151:     // score text with slight shadow
152:     ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
153:     ctx.shadowOffsetX = 1;
154:     ctx.shadowOffsetY = 1;
155:     ctx.shadowBlur = 2;
156:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
157:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
158:     ctx.fillText(`Score: ${Math.floor(distance)}`, 10, 20);
159:     ctx.shadowColor = 'transparent';
160: 
161:     // game over overlay
162:     if (gameOver) {
163:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.6)';
164:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
165:       ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
166:       ctx.font = '24px sans-serif';
167:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', canvas.width / 2 - 60, canvas.height / 2);
168:     }
169:   }
170: 
171:   let lastTime = performance.now();
172:   function loop() {
173:     const now = performance.now();
174:     const dt = now - lastTime;
175:     lastTime = now;
176:     update(dt);
177:     draw();
178:     requestAnimationFrame(loop);
179:   }
180: 
181:   // input
182:   function jump() {
183:     if (player.onGround && !gameOver) {
184:       player.vy = jumpStrength;
185:       player.onGround = false;
186:     } else if (gameOver) {
187:       reset();
188:     }
189:   }
190:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => { if (e.code === 'Space') jump(); });
191:   canvas.addEventListener('pointerdown', jump);
192: 
193:   reset();
194:   loop();
195: })();

(End of file - total 195 lines)
</content>
